description: Dependency updates as in 05.01 §3.3 (C-019, C-022): grouped by ecosystem, 7 days before a new version is proposed, no automatic merge. Every update is opened only when it is approved in the Dependency Dashboard; vulnerability fixes keep the Renovate default and open at once. Pull requests are drafts, so the PR checks run only after they are marked ready for review, and at most 2 are open at a time. Branches are created only on Monday before 6 a.m. (America/Guayaquil).
